<style>
.lc-widget {
  --lc-bg: #161a1c;
  --lc-panel: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.055);
  --lc-panel-strong: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.095);
  --lc-text: #f4f7f8;
  --lc-soft: rgba(244, 247, 248, 0.72);
  --lc-faint: rgba(244, 247, 248, 0.48);
  --lc-line: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
  --lc-a: #75f0c0;
  --lc-b: #f3c96b;
  --lc-c: #8db8ff;
  --lc-d: #ff8ea1;
  --lc-e: #b995ff;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  width: min(100%, 1120px);
  margin: 24px auto;
  padding: clamp(18px, 3vw, 30px);
  border: 1px solid var(--lc-line);
  border-radius: 28px;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(117, 240, 192, 0.16), transparent 34%), radial-gradient(circle at bottom right, rgba(141, 184, 255, 0.12), transparent 32%), var(--lc-bg);
  color: var(--lc-text);
  font-family: Inter, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
  box-shadow: 0 22px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.lc-widget *,
.lc-widget *::before,
.lc-widget *::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
.lc-card-top {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 18px;
  margin-bottom: 22px;
}
.lc-kicker {
  margin: 0 0 8px;
  color: var(--lc-a);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.13em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.lc-widget h2 {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--lc-text);
  font-size: clamp(24px, 4vw, 38px);
  line-height: 1.08;
  letter-spacing: -0.04em;
}
.lc-widget h3 {
  margin: 0 0 8px;
  color: var(--lc-text);
  font-size: 17px;
  line-height: 1.2;
}
.lc-widget p {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--lc-soft);
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.55;
}
.lc-toggle-btn {
  appearance: none;
  border: 1px solid var(--lc-line);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
  color: var(--lc-text);
  padding: 10px 14px;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 800;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: transform 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.lc-toggle-btn:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  background: rgba(117, 240, 192, 0.15);
  border-color: rgba(117, 240, 192, 0.45);
}
.lc-table-wrap {
  overflow-x: auto;
  border: 1px solid var(--lc-line);
  border-radius: 22px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.035);
}
.lc-info-table {
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 680px;
  border-collapse: collapse;
}
.lc-info-table th,
.lc-info-table td {
  padding: 17px 18px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--lc-line);
  text-align: left;
  vertical-align: top;
}
.lc-info-table tr:last-child th,
.lc-info-table tr:last-child td {
  border-bottom: 0;
}
.lc-info-table th {
  width: 28%;
  color: var(--lc-text);
  font-size: 14px;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.035);
}
.lc-info-table td {
  color: var(--lc-soft);
  font-size: 15px;
}
.lc-info-table tr {
  transition: background 0.2s ease;
}
.lc-info-table tr:hover {
  background: rgba(117, 240, 192, 0.08);
}
.lc-brand-card.lc-compact .lc-info-table tr:nth-child(n+6) {
  display: none;
}
.lc-mini-note {
  padding-top: 10px;
  color: var(--lc-faint);
  font-size: 13px;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.lc-donut-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(240px, 380px) 1fr;
  gap: clamp(18px, 4vw, 34px);
  align-items: center;
}
.lc-donut {
  position: relative;
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 380px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: conic-gradient(var(--lc-a) 0 38%, var(--lc-b) 38% 62%, var(--lc-c) 62% 82%, var(--lc-d) 82% 100%);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08), 0 24px 55px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28);
}
.lc-donut::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 22%;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--lc-bg);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--lc-line);
}
.lc-donut-centre {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 3;
  inset: 32%;
  display: grid;
  place-content: center;
  text-align: center;
  border-radius: 50%;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.lc-donut-centre strong {
  display: block;
  font-size: clamp(17px, 3vw, 24px);
  letter-spacing: -0.04em;
}
.lc-donut-centre small {
  color: var(--lc-soft);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
}
.lc-segment {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 2;
  width: 34%;
  height: 34%;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  color: var(--lc-text);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  padding: 8px;
  font: inherit;
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: 12px;
  text-align: center;
  transition: transform 0.22s ease, background 0.22s ease, box-shadow 0.22s ease;
}
.lc-segment span {
  filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 7px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45));
}
.lc-seg-1 {
  top: 8%;
  right: 21%;
}
.lc-seg-2 {
  right: 7%;
  bottom: 28%;
}
.lc-seg-3 {
  left: 18%;
  bottom: 9%;
}
.lc-seg-4 {
  left: 6%;
  top: 27%;
}
.lc-segment:hover,
.lc-segment:focus-visible {
  transform: scale(1.12);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
  outline: none;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.11);
}
.lc-legend {
  display: grid;
  gap: 12px;
}
.lc-legend-item {
  position: relative;
  padding: 16px 16px 16px 20px;
  border: 1px solid var(--lc-line);
  border-radius: 20px;
  background: var(--lc-panel);
  transition: transform 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease;
}
.lc-legend-item::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: 16px;
  bottom: 16px;
  width: 4px;
  border-radius: 0 99px 99px 0;
}
.lc-item-1::before {
  background: var(--lc-a);
}
.lc-item-2::before {
  background: var(--lc-b);
}
.lc-item-3::before {
  background: var(--lc-c);
}
.lc-item-4::before {
  background: var(--lc-d);
}
.lc-legend-item:hover {
  transform: translateX(5px);
  background: var(--lc-panel-strong);
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
}
.lc-bars {
  display: grid;
  gap: 16px;
}
.lc-bar-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(210px, 310px) 1fr;
  gap: 18px;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 16px;
  border: 1px solid var(--lc-line);
  border-radius: 22px;
  background: var(--lc-panel);
  transition: transform 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease;
}
.lc-bar-row:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  background: var(--lc-panel-strong);
}
.lc-bar-label strong {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 5px;
  color: var(--lc-text);
  font-size: 16px;
}
.lc-bar-label span {
  color: var(--lc-soft);
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.4;
}
.lc-bar-track {
  height: 18px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.lc-bar-fill {
  position: relative;
  width: var(--lc-width);
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: inherit;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--lc-a), var(--lc-c));
  transform-origin: left;
  animation: lc-grow 1.1s ease both;
}
.lc-muted-fill {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--lc-b), var(--lc-d));
}
.lc-bar-fill span {
  position: absolute;
  right: 8px;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  color: #101314;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 900;
  opacity: 0;
}
.lc-show-values .lc-bar-fill span {
  opacity: 1;
}
.lc-market-note {
  margin-top: 20px;
  padding: 18px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(117, 240, 192, 0.28);
  border-radius: 22px;
  background: rgba(117, 240, 192, 0.08);
}
@keyframes lc-grow {
  from {
    transform: scaleX(0);
  }
  to {
    transform: scaleX(1);
  }
}
@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .lc-card-top {
    flex-direction: column;
  }
  .lc-toggle-btn,
  .lc-mini-note {
    align-self: flex-start;
  }
  .lc-donut-layout {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .lc-bar-row {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .lc-info-table {
    min-width: 560px;
  }
  .lc-widget {
    border-radius: 22px;
  }
}
@media (max-width: 460px) {
  .lc-segment {
    font-size: 10px;
  }
  .lc-info-table th,
  .lc-info-table td {
    padding: 14px;
  }
}
</style>

<script>
(function () {
  const bonusWidgets = document.querySelectorAll('[data-lc-widget="bonus-visual"]');

  bonusWidgets.forEach(function (widget) {
    const segments = widget.querySelectorAll('.lc-segment');
    const legendItems = widget.querySelectorAll('.lc-legend-item');

    function clearActive() {
      segments.forEach(function (segment) {
        segment.classList.remove('lc-active');
      });

      legendItems.forEach(function (item) {
        item.classList.remove('lc-active');
      });
    }

    segments.forEach(function (segment, index) {
      segment.addEventListener('mouseenter', function () {
        clearActive();
        segment.classList.add('lc-active');
        if (legendItems[index]) {
          legendItems[index].classList.add('lc-active');
        }
      });

      segment.addEventListener('focus', function () {
        clearActive();
        segment.classList.add('lc-active');
        if (legendItems[index]) {
          legendItems[index].classList.add('lc-active');
        }
      });

      segment.addEventListener('click', function () {
        const isActive = segment.classList.contains('lc-active');
        clearActive();

        if (!isActive) {
          segment.classList.add('lc-active');
          if (legendItems[index]) {
            legendItems[index].classList.add('lc-active');
          }
        }
      });
    });

    widget.addEventListener('mouseleave', clearActive);
  });

  const marketWidgets = document.querySelectorAll('[data-lc-widget="market-edge"]');

  marketWidgets.forEach(function (widget) {
    const rows = widget.querySelectorAll('.lc-bar-row');

    rows.forEach(function (row) {
      row.addEventListener('click', function () {
        rows.forEach(function (item) {
          if (item !== row) {
            item.classList.remove('lc-active');
          }
        });

        row.classList.toggle('lc-active');
      });
    });
  });

  const brandWidgets = document.querySelectorAll('[data-lc-widget="brand-info"]');

  brandWidgets.forEach(function (widget) {
    const rows = widget.querySelectorAll('.lc-info-table tr');

    rows.forEach(function (row) {
      row.addEventListener('click', function () {
        rows.forEach(function (item) {
          if (item !== row) {
            item.classList.remove('lc-active');
          }
        });

        row.classList.toggle('lc-active');
      });
    });
  });
})();
</script>
<style>
.lc-segment.lc-active {
  transform: scale(1.14);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.13), 0 14px 28px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.24);
}

.lc-legend-item.lc-active {
  transform: translateX(7px);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
  border-color: rgba(117, 240, 192, 0.42);
}

.lc-bar-row.lc-active {
  background: rgba(117, 240, 192, 0.11);
  border-color: rgba(117, 240, 192, 0.38);
}

.lc-brand-card .lc-info-table tr.lc-active {
  background: rgba(117, 240, 192, 0.12);
}

.lc-brand-card .lc-info-table tr.lc-active th {
  color: var(--lc-a);
}
</style>

About the Author

Whether she is discussing online pokies, live dealer tables, crypto payments or account safety, the goal is to help readers slow down, check the important details and make better decisions before money is involved.

Hannah also believes responsible gambling should not be tucked away at the bottom of a page as an afterthought. Her guides regularly remind players to set limits, avoid chasing losses, understand wagering rules and treat gambling as paid entertainment rather than a source of income. When a casino looks exciting, she still asks the less glamorous questions: how does the cashier work, what happens at withdrawal, and what support is available if play stops feeling fun?

Her reviews are written for adults who want clear, useful information without hype. The aim is not to push players into a quick sign-up, but to give them enough context to understand what a brand offers, where the weak points may be and what should be checked before joining. Responsible Gambling

Our Approach to Safer Play

Casino games are based on chance. Pokies, roulette, blackjack, baccarat and live dealer games are designed with a house edge, which means the operator has a mathematical advantage over time.

Be Careful with Bonuses

Bonuses can make a casino offer look more exciting, but they often include wagering requirements, maximum bet rules, game restrictions, expiry dates and withdrawal limits. A bonus is not free money if it locks you into play you did not plan.

Warning Signs of Gambling Harm

  • You chase losses after a bad session
  • You increase your stakes to feel the same excitement
  • You feel restless, angry or anxious when you cannot gamble
  • You borrow money, use credit or sell things to keep playing
  • You tell yourself one more deposit will fix the problem
  • You lose track of time while playing online
  • You feel guilty after gambling but return again soon after

  • Do not use gambling as an escape from debt or personal pressure
  • Keep gambling separate from savings, rent and credit cards
  • Do not open extra accounts to avoid limits
  • Stop as soon as gambling stops feeling fun

Online Gambling and Mobile Play

Mobile gambling can be especially risky because it is private, quick and available at almost any time. A short session on the couch can stretch into an hour before you realise it, especially with fast pokies or live casino games.

If you play on mobile, use time reminders, keep your deposit method away from impulse spending and avoid gambling late at night. A tired brain makes poor decisions, and online casinos do not close at midnight.

When to Take a Break

Take a break if you feel annoyed, rushed, desperate or convinced that a win is just around the corner. Those feelings are not signs to keep playing; they are signs to step away.

A cooling-off period can help reset your thinking. Even a day away from gambling can make it easier to see whether you were playing for entertainment or trying to recover losses.

If gambling is causing stress, debt, arguments, secrecy or loss of control, support is available in Australia. You do not need to wait until things are completely cooked before asking for help.

  • National Debt Helpline: 1800 007 007
  • Emergency help: call 000 if someone is in immediate danger

Professional support can help with gambling urges, financial pressure, relationship stress and practical steps for taking control again.

For Family and Friends

If someone close to you may be struggling with gambling, look for changes in mood, secrecy around money, unexplained debts, repeated borrowing, missing time or defensiveness when gambling is mentioned.

Approach the conversation calmly. Blame and shouting rarely help. Clear concern, practical support and professional help are more useful than trying to force someone to stop through pressure alone.

Our Reminder

Leon Casino and any other gambling brand should be approached with a clear budget, clear limits and a clear reason for playing. If the reason becomes stress, debt, boredom or chasing losses, it is time to stop.

Gambling is never a reliable way to earn money. The safest session is one you can afford, control and walk away from without regret.
